title: The Illusion of Clinical Reasoning: A Benchmark Reveals the Pervasive Gap in Vision-Language Models for Clinical Competency
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the clinical diagnostic competency and multimodal reasoning of AI models in the field of orthopedics. While it mentions 'patient safety' and 'text-dominance bias,' it does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as part of its benchmark framework.
